thesis: Moral beauty concerns the form of action but respect cannot depend on being aesthetically admirable.

ideas.statement: Ethics and aesthetics interact without identity: tact can matter to care, yet elegant appearances can evade responsibility and clumsy goodness still counts.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Elevation experiments show bounded helping effects, not lasting virtue; aesthetic autonomy and ethical criticism require context-specific examination.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Elevation experiments show bounded helping effects, not lasting virtue; aesthetic autonomy and ethical criticism require context-specific examination.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM reading of all units; methodological and normative boundaries retained.
